videos.title: A Veterinarian's Journey Across 4 Continents & 6 Countries | Dr Fortune Sithole's Experiences Part 2
description: What does it take to build a career in veterinary medicine across four continents and six different countries? 🌍🐾
In this fascinating interview, we sit down with Dr Fortune Sithole a veterinarian whose educational and professional journey has taken them across **4 continents and 6 countries**.

From navigating different educational environments to experiencing diverse cultures and perspectives, this conversation explores the journey behind becoming a veterinary doctor and the experiences that come with pursuing an international career.
We discuss the world of  international education, professional development and cultural adaptation, and the lessons learned along the way.

Whether you are an aspiring veterinarian, a university student, a healthcare professional, or someone fascinated by extraordinary international career journeys, this interview offers an opportunity to learn from a professional with a global perspective.

**IN THIS INTERVIEW, WE EXPLORE:**
- The journey into veterinary medicine.
- Studying and pursuing education across different countries.
- Experiences of living and learning across four continents.
- Cultural differences in education and professional environments.
- The opportunities and challenges of an international career.
- Lessons for students considering veterinary medicine.
- How international exposure can broaden professional perspectives.
**JOIN THE CONVERSATION!**
Would you consider studying in six different countries if it meant gaining a broader international perspective?

videos.title: My BREAST CANCER Journey
description: Cheryl Lewis a Breast Cancer Survivor Shares Her Powerful Story | Journey Through Diagnosis, Treatment, Faith and Hope

What does it really take to face breast cancer and find the strength to keep going? In this heartfelt and inspiring interview, a breast cancer survivor opens up about her personal journey, sharing the realities of receiving a breast cancer diagnosis, navigating treatment, facing emotional and physical challenges, and finding the courage to fight through difficult moments.

Cheryl Lewis  takes us beyond the diagnosis to discuss the fears, uncertainties, support systems, and life-changing experiences that shaped her journey. From the importance of early detection and regular breast cancer screening to the power of family support, faith, resilience, and hope, this conversation offers encouragement and valuable insights for women and families.

Whether you are a breast cancer survivor, currently undergoing treatment, supporting someone with cancer, or simply seeking greater awareness, this interview is a reminder that no one should have to face the journey alone.
In this interview, we explore:

- The experience of receiving a breast cancer diagnosis.
- The emotional impact of living with breast cancer.
- Navigating breast cancer treatment and recovery.
- The importance of early detection and breast awareness.
- The role of family, friends, and emotional support.
- Finding strength, faith, and hope during difficult times.
- Life after breast cancer and lessons learned.
💗 A message to every woman: Know your body, pay attention to changes, attend recommended screenings, and seek medical advice when something doesn't feel right.
If this story touches you, please LIKE, SHARE, and SUBSCRIBE. Your share could encourage someone who needs hope today.

videos.title: Depression Is Not A Sign of Weakness. Seek Help | Dr Fortune Sithole
description: **Depression Is Real: There Is Nothing Weak About Asking for Help | Mental Health Awareness**
https://youtu.be/5qmm7aPmvCk?is=EIF050RsAzThI7Bb

Dr Fortune Sithole  associate dean for student affairs at Lincoln Memorial University College of Veterinary Medicine  speaks about Depresion.
Depression is not a sign of weakness, and asking for help is not something to be ashamed of. 💙 Sometimes, the strongest thing you can do is admit that you are struggling and reach out for support. He encourages students to seek help.

In this YouTube Short, we highlight the importance of mental health awareness, breaking the stigma surrounding depression especially in the African community of students, and encouraging people to seek professional help when they need it. **Remember:** You are not weak because you need help. Your mental health matters, your feelings matter, and you deserve support.

videos.title: African Parents Sacrificed for Their Children’s Education out of Love❤️ | Dr Z Ncube & Dr P Ncube
description: How much are parents willing to sacrifice to give their children a better future? ❤️

In this heartfelt conversation, parents share how they prioritized investing in their children’s education, even when it meant putting their own needs and desires aside. Their story highlights the sacrifices parents make, the power of education, and the love behind building a brighter future for the next generation.
The Bible reminds us of the importance of honoring our parents:
📖 **Ephesians 6:2–3 (KJV):** “Honor thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;) That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.”

videos.title: Why These Doctors Let Their Kids Say NO | Parenting for Confidence & Self-Esteem: Dr Z & Dr P Ncube
description: Proverbs 22:6 "Train up a child in the way he should go; even when he is old he will not depart from it.

What if teaching your children to say **“NO” to you** could actually help protect them from peer pressure? Dr Zebron Ncube and Dr Peggy Ncube explain in this powerful conversation. They are a married couple who are both doctors explain why they intentionally allowed their children to say no to them as parents. Their goal was to help their children develop **self-esteem, confidence, boundaries, decision-making skills, and the ability to say no to peers** when necessary.
Instead of teaching children to simply obey every voice around them, they wanted them to learn how to think for themselves, communicate their boundaries, and confidently make healthy choices.
This parenting strategy raises an important question: **Can giving children a safe space to say NO at home prepare them to say NO outside the home?**
Watch the full conversation and tell us: **Would you allow your children to say no to you?**

description: Proverbs 12:25 Anxiety in a man's heart weighs him down but a good word cheers him up.

In this powerful marriage conversation, we explore how unresolved pain, past experiences, disappointment, and emotional wounds can shape the way spouses communicate. Sometimes the argument isn’t really about what happened today. It’s about pain that was never addressed yesterday.

💔 How does emotional hurt affect communication between husbands and wives?
🗣️ Are you arguing about the issue, or reacting from an old wound?
❤️ Can couples learn to communicate without attacking, blaming, or shutting down?
Healthy communication starts with understanding the hurt beneath the words.
Watch, reflect, and share your thoughts: Have you ever realized that pain was influencing the way you communicated with your spouse?

videos.title: Why is Your Spouse The Hardest Person to Talk To? | Marriage Advice
description: Proverbs 15:1-A soft answer turns away wrath( anger ) but a harsh word stirs up wrath(anger)

ou can laugh, open up, and have meaningful conversations with friends, coworkers, or even strangers, yet struggle to talk honestly with the person you married.Dr J Papu explains this matter.
In this powerful marriage conversation, we explore communication in marriage, emotional safety, vulnerability, trust, and why couples sometimes shut down when talking to each other.
Is it fear of conflict? Feeling misunderstood? Past hurt? Or simply not knowing how to have difficult conversations without turning them into arguments?
Healthy marriage communication requires more than talking. It requires feeling heard, respected, and safe enough to be honest.

videos.title: I drank everyday at work!
description: 2 Corinthians 12:9  My Grace Is Sufficient For You For My Power is made perfect in weakness.....
What happens when alcohol addiction follows you into the workplace?

In this powerful recovery testimony, a former alcohol addict reveals how he was drinking every day at work while hiding his addiction from the people around him. His honest story exposes the reality of alcoholism, functioning addiction, and how easily drinking can become part of everyday life.
If you or someone you love is struggling with alcohol addiction, alcoholism, or recovery, this conversation may help you recognize the warning signs and understand that recovery is possible.
🎥 Watch, listen, and share this testimony with someone who may need to hear it.

videos.title: He Drank After Church While Serving as a Youth Leader | Alcohol Addiction Testimony
description:
Proverbs 23:31-32
He went to church. He served as a youth leader. Then he went home and drank.#Esigodini

In this powerful and honest recovery testimony, a recovered alcohol addict shares how he was able to drink after church while serving as a youth leader, revealing the hidden reality of alcohol addiction.

His story challenges the idea that addiction always looks obvious. Behind church involvement, leadership, family responsibilities, and a respected public image, someone can be privately struggling with alcohol abuse and addiction.
This emotional conversation explores alcohol addiction, hidden alcoholism, Christian faith, church leadership, youth ministry, recovery, addiction awareness, and redemption.
If you or someone you love is struggling with alcohol, this story may help you recognize that addiction can affect anyone, regardless of their faith or position.
Watch the full interview for his journey from alcohol addiction to recovery.

In this powerful and honest conversation, our guest , Innocent Mathe opens up about how alcohol entered their life, what was happening emotionally at the time, and how casual drinking eventually became a serious struggle with alcohol addiction.
Many people only see the addiction. They don't always see where it started, what pain was underneath it, or how quickly drinking can become a problem.
This conversation explores alcohol addiction, alcoholism recovery, the causes of drinking, emotional struggles, addiction and family, and the journey toward recovery.

videos.title: Why do married couples avoid the conversations they need to have most? Dr Papu explains real reason!
description: Why do married couples avoid the conversations they need to have most? Dr J Papu explains in this video 💔
Sometimes, it’s not because couples don’t know WHAT to say. It’s because they’re afraid of the PAIN that might come with saying it.

Unresolved hurt, disappointment, rejection, betrayal, and fear of conflict can make couples choose silence over honesty. But avoiding difficult conversations doesn’t make the pain disappear. It can allow distance and resentment to grow.

In this powerful conversation, we explore why married couples struggle with communication, how emotional pain affects marriage, and what it takes to have difficult conversations without destroying the relationship.
💬 Question: Is fear of pain one of the biggest reasons couples avoid difficult conversations?
👇 Share your thoughts in the comments.

videos.title: ALCOHOL ADDICTION RECOVERY AND HOPE | Innocent Mathe Story
description: FROM ALCOHOL ADDICTION TO FREEDOM: A POWERFUL JOURNEY OF RECOVERY AND HOPE by Mr Innocent Mathe
What happens when alcohol addiction takes control of your life, your relationships, and your future? And what does it take to break free?
In this powerful and honest interview, Mr Innocent Mathee a  recovered alcohol addict shares their personal journey from **alcohol addiction and struggle to recovery, freedom, and a renewed life**.
This is more than a story about addiction. It is a story about **courage, accountability, family, faith, healing, and the possibility of a new beginning.**

Our guest Mr  Innocent Mathe opens up about what led to alcohol addiction, the impact it had on relationships and family, the turning point that changed everything, and what recovery looks like today.
💬 **In this interview, we discuss:**

* How alcohol addiction began
* The warning signs that alcohol was becoming a problem
* What addiction looked like behind closed doors
* How alcoholism affected family and loved ones
* The emotional and relational consequences of addiction
* The moment that became a turning point
* What helped make recovery possible
* The challenges of staying sober
* Rebuilding trust with family and loved ones
* Overcoming shame and guilt
* Finding purpose after addiction
* What the recovery journey really looks like
* A powerful message for anyone struggling with alcohol addiction

**If you are struggling with alcohol addiction, this conversation is a reminder that your story does not have to end where your addiction began. Recovery is possible, and asking for help can be the beginning of a different chapter.**

videos.title: Why I am Proud To Be My Father's Son Dr Thomas Achia | Fatherhood Lessons, Legacy & Leadership
description: Dr Thomas Achia came prepared to give a tribute to his father Engineer Joshua Achia. The conversation starts with Dr Thomas remembering his early child hood memories with his father. He explains how he was raised as a boy by a very educated man in the early seventies.

He talks about navigating teenage years and how he learnt about women by observing how his father did it. He explains the dynamics of communication during that time. He also covers several topics that he learnt from his father on parenting and building a strong work ethic, leadership and spirituality.

Dr Thomas Achia highlighted the need for a full time mother during developmental ages of children and the need for a father to provide and work. In his quest to emphasize his view on the father's role in the family he touched on the strength of the father's voice for correction and discipline.
The conversation also touches on family unity and how the father is a plays a pivotal role with regards to inculcating the pride and legacy of the family.
In closing Dr Thomas Achia declares his love for my father

****If you would like to celebrate or make noise about your father or any topic that is beneficial to families please indicate that in the comment section****
